name: prv_cut_boundary
about: T2 is observed in exactly 3 of 10 samples and prv_cut is 0.3, so its prevalence equals the cut. `ancombc_prep.R` filters on `prevalence >= prv_cut`, so T2 is kept and T3 (2/10) is not. ANCOMBC 2.15.2 has no `perc_thres`; `prv_cut` is the nearest one and this is the documented substitution
